description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetStreamFailureHandler class, specifically testing its behavior against different database systems (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL). It includes setup for testing environment, construction tests, and failure handling tests related to dead letter queue processing in Orleans streaming with ADO.NET.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetStreamFailureHandlerTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetStreamFailureHandler against SQL Server.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetStreamFailureHandlerTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetStreamFailureHandler against MySQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetStreamFailureHandlerTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetStreamFailureHandler against PostgreSQL.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamFailureHandlerTests
classes.description: Abstract base class containing common setup and tests for AdoNetStreamFailureHandler, parameterized by database invariant.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment, including database connection and queries.

methods.name: AdoNetStreamFailureHandler_Constructs
methods.description: Tests that the AdoNetStreamFailureHandler can be constructed with given options.

methods.name: AdoNetStreamFailureHandler_OnDeliveryFailure_MovesPoisonedMessageToDeadLetters
methods.description: Verifies that a poisoned message is moved to dead letters upon delivery failure.

methods.name: AdoNetStreamFailureHandler_OnDeliveryFailure_DoesNotMoveHealthyMessageToDeadLetters
methods.description: Verifies that healthy messages are not moved to dead letters upon delivery failure.
